title: THE SCAV PISTOL KICKS THE SCREEN A LITTLE
why: His Q5: gun feel. The camera shake is 18 px times trauma squared, so the flat 2.2 kick was 0.4 px, nothing you could see. The Scav Pistol (the gun every party guest starts with) now sets 3.6: about 1.2 px a shot, 1.0 px over six taps at full rate.
now: The Scav Pistol now gives the screen a small kick with every shot.

edits.replacement: var GUN_SHAKE={shotgun:6.5,smg:1.9,pistol:3.6};   // v28.xx (cw-kickpistol): the Scav Pistol 2.2 to 3.6, one tap 0.4 px to 1.2 px of camera kick (trauma 0.157 to 0.257, size 18 x trauma squared); six taps at its 290 ms rate stay under 1.1 px
